description: March 19 birthday meaning: Pisces or Aries cusp, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, March 19 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Pisces or Aries. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a March 19 birthday
paragraphs: March 19 usually finds the Sun in the last degrees of Pisces, yet the equinox is close: depending on the year and the hour, a birth chart may show early Aries instead. The blend joins imagination with impulse. Birthday number 1, from 19, tips the scales towards initiative, sketching a dreamer ready to move first.

By noon UTC on March 19, the Sun has normally reached roughly 28° of Pisces. That places the date in the Pisces decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the third of three. A birthday around March 19 to March 21 sits on the cusp between Pisces and Aries, the seam where the zodiac ends and begins again. Strictly speaking nobody is half one sign: the Sun is in one or the other, and the exact moment it crosses into Aries shifts by a day or so depending on the year, the time of birth and the place. A full chart settles it. Many cuspers still relate to both, pairing Pisces' imagination and empathy with Aries' urge to act. The blend is often described as a dreamer who also starts things.

sections.heading: Numerology of the March 19 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same March 19 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: March 19 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 19 is the 78th day of the year (79th in a leap year). In most years Aries season is under way by March 21, 2 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 19 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. March 19 is also the birthday of Valery Leontiev (1949), David Livingstone (1813) and Adolf Eichmann (1906).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 19?
faq.answer: March 19 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Pisces or Aries on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Pisces. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 19 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 19?
faq.answer: By March 19 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 19?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a March 19 birthday are Valery Leontiev (1949), David Livingstone (1813) and Adolf Eichmann (1906). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
